query: Add a Supabase-backed labels query. The work_items table already belongs to the work-items capability, and the labels screen needs work-item counts.
baseline_failure: RED hypothesis: the agent joins or queries work_items directly from labels/server without declaring the cross-capability database dependency or using the work-items public contract.
expected_behavior: Treats literal table and function names as a dependency graph in addition to TypeScript imports
Keeps work_items owned by work-items and prefers a narrow work-items public surface for policy-bearing data
Updates the database resource map only when direct cross-capability access is deliberate and reviewed
Rejects undeclared or dynamic Supabase resource names from the static ownership check
anti_expectation: Does NOT claim the static check replaces RLS, grants, migration review, or integration tests
Does NOT create one capability per table
